prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Cedar Falls Municipal Drinking Water Treatment Plant. Aliases:Ironwood=River Intake Pump Station;Marigold=Coagulant Dosing Skid;Cobalt=North Filter Gallery;Sparrow=Laboratory Sample Receiving Bench;Lantern=SCADA Historian Server;Quarry=Maintenance Planner;Juniper=High Service Pump Header;Falcon=Distribution Dispatcher. Items:Raw Water Screen Channel→Quarry:Rake Torque Snapshot;Marigold→Laboratory Technician:Alum Batch Ticket;technician produces Sample Chain Slip;Sparrow receives samples,produces checked Jar Test Photograph Set(“the set”=dose confirmation);South Filter Gallery→Chief Operator:Filter Run Exception Note;Chemical Supplier Driver produces Chlorine Cylinder Seal Log(Duty Engineer reviews before unloading/storage change);Clearwell Level Controller produces Clearwell Diver Entry Permit(level/isolation checks;Quarry verifies isolation);Juniper produces threshold-triggered Pump Bearing Vibration Clip(“the clip”;Quarry uses for inspection/corrective priorities);Chief Operator verifies Backwash Solids Manifest(Residuals Hauler confirms load/destination/acceptance,removes residuals);Falcon sends verified Pressure Zone Handoff Card(“the card”;South Distribution Pressure Station verifies status/valves/communications). Requirements:intake permissives/alarm-stop;Chief Operator authorizes Storm Intake Mode(debris/quality/screening/dose dependencies),drilled prompts/constraints/restoration. Approved dosing;unreliable indications hold. Sample custody/acceptance;late/warm troubleshooting-only. Backwash Recovery Tank return settling/clarity;Cobalt staggered verified washes;South breakthrough/delayed-ripening exclusion approval. Maintenance/overrides approval,isolation,monitoring,evidence,restoration;upsets→Duty Engineer;Chlorine Residual Alarm pauses maintenance/capacity increases,test annunciation/guidance/acknowledgement/escalation. Testing:Ironwood/screens/galleries/Marigold local-supervisory response;Juniper startup/lead-lag/shutdown stability;Lantern time/tags/retention/trend-retrieval;Chlorine Contact Basin/controller representative level/flow/residual before routine release. Juniper monitors pressure/reservoir/pump/field trends,notifies Falcon of header/station failures affecting reserves/zones/fire-flow. Approved automatic sequencing;manual/local recorded;communications-loss retains confirmed mode;radio/phone station/valve/direction/completion. Readiness verifies

New part:
S246: The Chemical Supplier Driver shall follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures established during commissioning and confirmed during training.
S247: Records generated during commissioning and early operation shall be complete enough to support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training.
S248: Records retention shall follow municipal policy and applicable drinking water requirements, with electronic records protected against unauthorized change and accidental loss.
S249: Periodic performance reviews shall compare actual plant operation with the control concept, including alarm burden, manual interventions, water quality stability, chemical use, and energy use.
S250: Continuous improvement actions shall be prioritized by risk, reviewed by the Chief Operator and Duty Engineer, tested before release, and incorporated into updated procedures and training materials.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
